title: LHDS PDP decision input
description: Reconciled with the W1-4 token-claims contract lhds-at/1 (docs/fiab/health/security.md section A7/A8, PR #5127). The PDP verifies the AS-signed token itself (ES384 against data.lhds.config.jwks) and reads claims from the verified payload, so the interceptor passes the RAW token, never pre-parsed claims. Request-side fields are the interceptor contract owned by W1-5; patient_compartment and categories were confirmed for FHIR by W2-3; the DICOM side is still unconfirmed (W3-3).

access_token.description: Raw compact JWT: typ at+jwt, alg ES384, lhds_ver lhds-at/1. Claims checked: iss, aud (single string), exp, iat, jti, lhds_ver, tenant, sub, sub_type, client_id, scope (v2 form), lhds_roles, lhds_map_ver, pou, patient (patient/ scopes), idp_tid (user). act or cnf present = deny. pou BTG = deny (W1). Any missing claim = deny.

interaction.description: fhir: read|vread|history|search|create|update|patch|delete|operation. dicom: wado|qido|stow|delete. Keys of data.lhds.interactions.

tenant.description: Tenant slug resolved from the URL or host by the interceptor, never from the body. Compared to the tenant claim exactly (no case-folding or trimming).

base.description: The tenant public FHIR base (the engine configured server address, hapi.fhir.server_address = <stampBaseUrl>/<tenant>/fhir): no facility-partition segment, no trailing slash. NOT the URL as received. It is the audience the token must name. Must be one of the tenant's bases in data.lhds.stamp.

resource_type.description: fhir only, required: FHIR resource type of the target.

op.description: fhir interaction=operation only: e.g. $export. Gated by lhds_roles via the role-scope map.

patient_compartment.description: CONFIRMED by the FHIR interceptor (W2-3; DICOM side still W3-3), shape unchanged. Patient ids owning the target, resolved from the REQUEST before the engine runs: the id in Patient/{id}; the values of the patient / subject search params (a leading Patient/ stripped, comma lists split); _id on a Patient search; for create/update the Patient id or the Patient references (subject, patient, beneficiary) of the body. A read/vread of a non-Patient resource by id is UNBOUND (the owner is only known after the read). Required non-empty for patient/ scopes; empty means unbound and denies. Every owner must equal the token patient.

categories.description: CONFIRMED by the FHIR interceptor (W2-3), narrowed: for search, the values of the category query param exactly as received (comma lists split); for create/update, both the bare code and the system|code form of every category coding in the body. NOT sent for read/vread (unknown before the read), so a category-constrained scope cannot authorise a read by id; the response filter enforces the constraint on what is returned. Compared by exact string to the scope constraint value; system|code vs bare code forms are NOT normalised.
